title: What the Best-Graded Developer Portfolios Have in Common
subtitle: We analyze the AI judge scores to find out what sets top developer portfolios apart from the rest.
altTitles: Decoding S and A Tier Developer Portfolios
What Makes a Top-Ranked Developer Portfolio
shareLine: Discover what the best-graded developer portfolios do differently.
newsletterBlurb: A deep dive into PortfolioRank scores showing how top developer portfolios excel in project storytelling and memorability.
body:
> **TL;DR**
> - Top portfolios lead by 1.7 points on project storytelling and memorability, representing a tie across 2 axes.
> - Only 16 portfolios achieve the top tier S grade out of 1,287 total graded sites.
> - Motion scores remain low across all groups, averaging 2.4 for top tiers and 1.7 for others.

[[image:hero]]

Top portfolios lead by 1.7 points on project storytelling and memorability, representing a tie across 2 axes.
We analyze AI judge scores across thousands of sites to see what separates the highest tier developer portfolios from the rest of the group.
Understanding these metrics helps you focus your design efforts where they matter most.

[[image:inline-1]]

### Visual Design and First Impressions

We measure visual design on a scale from one to five to see how well developer portfolios present themselves.
The average visual design score of S and A portfolios reaches 4.8.
Meanwhile, the average visual design score of all other graded portfolios sits at 3.2.

We also test how quickly visitors grasp the main point within a short window.
The average the five-second test score of S and A portfolios is 4.9.
For all other graded portfolios, that average is 4.5, making it the five-second test where the gap is smallest.

[[image:inline-2]]

### Storytelling and Memorability

The average project storytelling score of S and A portfolios stands at 3.8.
In contrast, the average project storytelling score of all other graded portfolios drops to 2.1.

The average memorability score of S and A portfolios hits 4.1.
For all other graded portfolios, the average memorability score is 2.4.

[[image:inline-3]]

### Writing and Motion Scores

We track how clear text and subtle motion appear across developer sites.
The highest graded portfolios reach an average writing score of 4.7, while other graded portfolios average 3.4.
Clear communication sets top builders apart from the rest.

> **23%**
> Share of all graded portfolios that are graded S or A

### Try this

1. Improve your visual design by studying [Aayush Bharti](https://aaabaa-aayush.vercel.app) and aiming for clarity in your layout.
2. Refine your project storytelling to make your case studies engaging and clear to visitors.
3. Polish your written content to ensure your explanations are concise and professional.

Review your own developer portfolio against these core benchmarks to find areas for immediate improvement.
Small adjustments to your project descriptions and layout can significantly elevate your overall presentation.

**Grade your portfolio on PortfolioRank** -> https://portfoliorank.n8builds.dev

title: Dark Mode, Motion, and Page Weight in Top Portfolios
subtitle: An aggregate look at what the capture measured on each portfolio.
altTitles: Measuring Dark Mode, Motion, and Page Weight
shareLine: See what top portfolios actually ship in our latest data analysis.
newsletterBlurb: Explore our latest findings on dark mode, motion, and page weight across developer portfolios.
body:
> **TL;DR**
> - Only 28% of S and A portfolios feature dark mode by default.
> - Top portfolios maintain a median page weight of 0.9 MB on first load.
> - Responsive design is strong, with 95% fitting a phone screen without sideways scrolling.

[[image:hero]]

Only 28% of S and A portfolios feature dark mode by default, which sets an interesting baseline for developer design choices.
We wanted to see what top sites actually ship compared to the rest of our dataset.
Our analysis breaks down appearance, motion, and page weight across thousands of graded portfolios.

[[image:inline-1]]

### Default Appearance Choices

We track how developer sites set up their initial visual style.
A share of 28% of S and A portfolios use dark mode by default.
In contrast, only a share of 19% of other portfolios make this choice.

### Motion and Responsiveness

We also measure page motion and mobile layout compatibility across all graded sites.
A share of 28% of S and A portfolios include motion on the page, while 18% of other portfolios do so.
A share of 95% of S and A portfolios fit a phone screen without sideways scrolling, compared to 88% of other portfolios.

### Performance and Errors

We checked console errors and found that 82% of top portfolios tie with 82% of other portfolios for clean code.
First load median page weight sits at 0.9 MB for top sites compared to 1.1 MB for the rest.
Network requests average 32 for top portfolios and 28 for other sites in our dataset.

> **Share of S and A portfolios with dark mode by default is 28%**
> This measurement reflects our aggregate findings on default visual themes across top developer portfolios.

### Try this

1. Review your portfolio for default dark mode styling.
2. Check your mobile layout to ensure it fits a phone screen without sideways scrolling.
3. Audit your first load page weight and network requests.

These measurements give us a clear look at current standards in developer portfolios.
We hope these insights help you refine your own site for better performance and usability.
